description: Verifies a deterministic collision of two disk-bulge-halo galaxies of 500 particles each evolved for fifteen Barnes-Hut leapfrog steps: the centre of mass drifts by less than 1e19 m and the magnitude of the total angular momentum changes by less than 5 percent.

checks.label: the centre of mass drift is finite
the angular momentum change is finite
the centre of mass drifts by less than 1e19 m
the total angular momentum changes by less than 5 percent
